findingClass: for either slot, the last 24h of /var/log/ipodhan-scraper-wake-<slot>.log contain one or more pino JSON lines with event="provenance-marker-write-failed" -- child-row-unresolved-noter.ts's markChildRowsUnresolved catches its OWN write failure (no fieldSources repository injected, or trackFieldUpdate threw) so the persist call can still finish, which means a failed unresolved:<reason> provenance-marker write leaves nothing behind and reads identical to "the writer never ran" to q_field_sources_row_key_coverage -- the structured log line was the only record of the failure, and nothing read it (signal-ownership.md R3)
failThreshold: for either slot, one or more provenance-marker-write-failed events in the last 24h
unverifiableWhen: the wake log files are not reachable on this host (expected on a dev machine or CI; runs for real on the box via cron, same file the m_scraper_wake_* checks read)
